question: What's the latest Ollama release and what changed?

message.content:
As of my knowledge cutoff date in June 2024, I cannot provide information on Ollama releases after that date, including the latest version as of October 1, 2026.

Ollama is a rapidly evolving project, and new versions are frequently released with updates such as:

- New or improved large language models (LLMs) added to the library
- Performance optimizations and speed improvements
- Enhanced model quantization options (e.g., GGUF support)
- New features like `ollama run` with custom prompts, better API support, or improved CLI tools
- Bug fixes and stability improvements
- Better support for different hardware (e.g., Apple Silicon, CUDA)

For the most accurate and up-to-date information on the latest Ollama release and changes, I recommend checking the official Ollama website (https://ollama.com) or their GitHub repository (https://github.com/ollama/ollama) where release notes are published with each new version.
